plain: The person named in a will to carry it out

webster.text: The person appointed by a testator to execute his will, or to see it carried into effect.

example.quote: Next year, an act was made restoring them to the executor of the proprietor.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 18, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
